status: Computational hypotheses, not biological experiments or independent peer review
uncertainty: No fitted perceptual dataset exists here. Parameter ranges are assumptions, not 95% confidence intervals.

taxonomy.scope: Rank reconciliation, not a complete phylogenetic inference. Historical provider values retained. Some authorities leave class/order unassigned; named intermediate ranks are displayed with their true rank.

loxodonta-africana.method: Blue–green camera proxy plus separate nominal A1 pigment calculation at 419/552 nm. Screen yellow/blue is a convention, not elephant color naming.
loxodonta-africana.evidence: Reconstituted elephant cone pigments peak near 419 and 552 nm; a rod pigment peaks near 496 nm.
loxodonta-africana.limits: Camera green is not the 552 nm cone. Rod contributions, retinal wiring, ocular filtering and brightness discrimination are not fitted.
loxodonta-africana.validation: Measure calibrated spectra and brightness-controlled behavior, with independent animals and stimuli.
loxodonta-africana.uncertainty: Scenario controls are not confidence intervals. No fitted perceptual dataset or independent validation.
loxodonta-africana.fixtureScope: Deterministic synthetic software fixture only, not ecological or perceptual evidence.

rows.label: Hypothetical UV contrast
rows.unit: Michelson contrast; both zero → undefined, displayed as 0

ambystoma-mexicanum.method: Keep RGB untouched. Calculate hypothetical UV Michelson contrast (target − background)/(target + background) from user-assigned reflectances under equal illumination.
ambystoma-mexicanum.evidence: Species-specific eye-cup recordings found ultraviolet sensitivity near 360–370 nm.
ambystoma-mexicanum.limits: No UV pattern is painted onto the photograph. UV reflectance and illumination are unmeasured; retinal sensitivity is not a behavioral color-discrimination result.
ambystoma-mexicanum.validation: Use independently measured UV spectra and ocular transmission, then test brightness-controlled discrimination. A normal phone cannot perform the required UV measurement.
ambystoma-mexicanum.uncertainty: Scenario controls are not confidence intervals. No fitted perceptual dataset or independent validation.
ambystoma-mexicanum.fixtureScope: Deterministic synthetic software fixture only, not ecological or perceptual evidence.

anguilla-rostrata.method: Blend linear RGB toward its luminance by an assigned weight. Show the reported 520/550 nm assay peaks separately; do not interpolate them into an invented pigment curve.
anguilla-rostrata.evidence: American eel eyecup studies found rod-dominated anatomy and different dark-adapted and flicker spectral sensitivities.
anguilla-rostrata.limits: The weight is not a measured rod/cone contribution or migration stage. A2 chromophore effects, neural adaptation and underwater spectra are not fitted.
anguilla-rostrata.validation: Separate stage, adaptation, irradiance and chromophore composition; fit trial-level data before predicting percepts.
anguilla-rostrata.uncertainty: Scenario controls are not confidence intervals. No fitted perceptual dataset or independent validation.
anguilla-rostrata.fixtureScope: Deterministic synthetic software fixture only, not ecological or perceptual evidence.

leptuca-pugilator.method: Retain an assigned horizontal band. Outside it, average linear RGB vertically, leaving horizontal sampling intact. Horizon location and band width are manually assigned.
leptuca-pugilator.evidence: Work published as Uca pugilator measured enhanced vertical sampling around the horizon and elevation-dependent responses to moving targets.
leptuca-pugilator.limits: The photograph is not at crab eye height. No 360° reconstruction, measured optical kernel, predator classification or automatic horizon detection is claimed.
leptuca-pugilator.validation: Fit eye geometry and pseudopupil measurements, then test independent target elevations and contrasts.
leptuca-pugilator.uncertainty: Scenario controls are not confidence intervals. No fitted perceptual dataset or independent validation.
leptuca-pugilator.fixtureScope: Deterministic synthetic software fixture only, not ecological or perceptual evidence.

callinectes-sapidus.method: Vary chromatic information while preserving linear sRGB luminance. This is a stimulus-control experiment; the default habitat is an untransformed RGB reference.
callinectes-sapidus.evidence: Behavioral experiments using female images and brightness comparisons support a role for claw hue in male mate choice.
callinectes-sapidus.limits: Device luminance is not crab isoluminance. No mate choice, spectral sensitivity or exact perceived claw color is predicted. Chemical and movement cues are absent.
callinectes-sapidus.validation: Use species receptor spectra and brightness controls, then independent behavioral choices. Do not call RGB desaturation a crab-eye reconstruction.
callinectes-sapidus.uncertainty: Scenario controls are not confidence intervals. No fitted perceptual dataset or independent validation.
callinectes-sapidus.fixtureScope: Deterministic synthetic software fixture only, not ecological or perceptual evidence.

nephrops-norvegicus.method: Use the selected reported angle as a square box-pooling width in an assigned field of view. Box pooling is an explanatory surrogate, not the measured angular sensitivity function.
nephrops-norvegicus.evidence: Submerged retinula-cell measurements reported 11.3° acceptance angles in dark adaptation and 8.85° in light adaptation.
nephrops-norvegicus.limits: No hexagonal mosaic, mirror ray tracing, biological noise or behavioral acuity is reconstructed. Acceptance angle and receptor spacing must remain distinct.
nephrops-norvegicus.validation: Obtain angular sensitivity curves and eye geometry, fit a point-spread function, then test held-out behavioral contrast thresholds.
nephrops-norvegicus.uncertainty: Scenario controls are not confidence intervals. No fitted perceptual dataset or independent validation.
nephrops-norvegicus.fixtureScope: Deterministic synthetic software fixture only, not ecological or perceptual evidence.

phocoena-phocoena.method: Paraxial illustrative angular blur diameter ≈ pupil diameter in metres × absolute defocus, in radians. Convert to degrees and box-pool at an assigned field of view.
phocoena-phocoena.evidence: A two-eye anatomical study and 2D ray model found direction-dependent refraction; the cornea helped counteract the strong crystalline lens.
phocoena-phocoena.limits: This is not a porpoise ray trace or a measured live-eye blur. Corneal geometry, astigmatism, accommodation and visual direction are omitted. No echolocation image is inferred.
phocoena-phocoena.validation: Fit measured eye surfaces and refractive indices; compare independent live-animal refraction and visual discrimination.
phocoena-phocoena.uncertainty: Scenario controls are not confidence intervals. No fitted perceptual dataset or independent validation.
phocoena-phocoena.fixtureScope: Deterministic synthetic software fixture only, not ecological or perceptual evidence.

caretta-caretta.method: Preserve linear sRGB luminance while varying saturation. This tests image information, not turtle cone responses. RGB habitat remains the neutral starting reference.
caretta-caretta.evidence: Juvenile loggerheads discriminated trained 450, 500 and 580 nm stimuli with intensity controls.
caretta-caretta.limits: The training wavelengths are stimuli, not pigment peaks. No subjective palette, adult generalization, measured color gamut or detection distance is inferred.
caretta-caretta.validation: Use calibrated target spectra and age-matched, brightness-controlled independent behavioral trials.
caretta-caretta.uncertainty: Scenario controls are not confidence intervals. No fitted perceptual dataset or independent validation.
caretta-caretta.fixtureScope: Deterministic synthetic software fixture only, not ecological or perceptual evidence.

chlamydomonas-reinhardtii.method: Collapse camera green to a mean linear value. Multiply by (1 + screening × cos(angle))/(1 + screening). Show a uniform intensity field: a scalar information diagram, never an algal scene.
chlamydomonas-reinhardtii.evidence: Channelrhodopsin-dependent currents and phototaxis have been measured in this unicellular green alga.
chlamydomonas-reinhardtii.limits: Camera green is a rough input proxy, not channelrhodopsin excitation. Eyespot optics, action spectra, photocurrents, swimming and adaptation are not fitted.
chlamydomonas-reinhardtii.validation: Fit measured angular responses and currents, then predict independent trajectories. Photon flux and membrane voltage require measurements beyond a phone RGB camera.
chlamydomonas-reinhardtii.uncertainty: Scenario controls are not confidence intervals. No fitted perceptual dataset or independent validation.
chlamydomonas-reinhardtii.fixtureScope: Deterministic synthetic software fixture only, not ecological or perceptual evidence.

rows.label: Hypothetical step-up input
rows.unit: relative; not cAMP or response probability

euglena-gracilis.method: Calculate max(0, later − prior) from assigned relative blue inputs. Camera blue is spatially averaged and shown as a uniform field; the separate step is hypothetical, not a measured cellular response.
euglena-gracilis.evidence: Photoactivated adenylyl cyclase was linked to the step-up photophobic response in Euglena gracilis.
euglena-gracilis.limits: No image-forming eye, cAMP concentration, response probability or avoidance trajectory is predicted. Phone exposure changes can mimic light changes.
euglena-gracilis.validation: Fit calibrated irradiance, PAC activity and independent behavioral time series; distinguish photophobic steps from continuous phototaxis.
euglena-gracilis.uncertainty: Scenario controls are not confidence intervals. No fitted perceptual dataset or independent validation.
euglena-gracilis.fixtureScope: Deterministic synthetic software fixture only, not ecological or perceptual evidence.
